tha-ap479:1.1: Giripunnāgiya.] Sobhito nāma sambuddho Cittakuṭe vasī tadā / gahetvā giripunnāgaṃ sayambhum abhipūjayiṃ // //
tha-ap479:2.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap479:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Giripunnāgiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
